rundown: Bruins beat Red Wings 4-1 at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, MI in front of 18,340. Bruins led 2-1 after two periods and never looked back. The 2nd period decided it: Bruins won it 2-0.
5 goals in all. Bruins's last: Casey Mittelstadt Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Pavel Zacha (11), 3rd period 19:05.
Leading the way — Bruins: Pavel Zacha 1 goal; Mason Lohrei 2 ast; David Pastrnak 2 pts. Red Wings: Lucas Raymond 1 goal, 1 pts; Andrew Copp 1 ast.
Where Bruins won it: they outshot them 31-21, scored 1 on the power play to 0 and out-hit them 27-18.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Red Wings closed as 1.5-goal favorites and lost outright to Bruins; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 5, under by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 18, 7:26 PM ET. It had Bruins 52% and Red Wings 48%, projecting Bruins 2.8 – Red Wings 2.7 (5.5 total, Bruins by 0.1).

Final: Bruins 4 – Red Wings 1. Right winner: it had Bruins at 52%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bruins came in with a 3% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (13-7-1, 3.4 scored and 2.6 allowed a game over 21 games), worth about 78 and 78 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.8, they scored 4 (+1.2 goals, 43% over); projected to allow 2.7, they allowed 1 (−1.7 goals, 63% under).

Red Wings came in with a 5% below average attack and a league-average defense (8-10-3, 2.7 scored and 3 allowed a game over 21 games), worth about 79 and 79 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.7, they scored 1 (−1.7 goals, 63% under); projected to allow 2.8, they allowed 4 (+1.2 goals, 43% over).

The bigger miss was Red Wings' scoring (-1.7 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 5 against 5.5 projected (-0.5), about the 42nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Bruins by 3 against Bruins by 0.1 projected, about the 12th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
DET ML (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 50%). BOS ML (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 50%). DET -1.5 (+230) at +230: the algo gave it 29% vs 29% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. BOS +1.5 (-285) at -285: the algo gave it 71% vs 71% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.4u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (+114) at +114: the algo gave it 44% vs 45% fair (-0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-135) at -135: the algo gave it 56% vs 55% fair (+0.8 pts) — won (+0.7u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 74% of bets on Bruins, 86% of the money — Bruins covered; total: 69% of bets on the over, 70% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 61% of bets on Bruins, 83% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Bruins, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.875 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -3.1 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 99 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.946 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Bruins attack ×0.960, defense ×0.978 (6 games); Red Wings attack ×0.960, defense ×0.960 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.9 goals), no bet.
